title: Unsanitized Path Parameter in Media Upload Allows Arbitrary Bucket Key Overwrite
description: POST /api/admin/upload-image in server/routes/adminRoutes.ts accepts an optional path parameter from the client request body. The path value is passed directly to supabaseServer.storage.from("product-images").upload(uploadPath, ..., { upsert: true }) without verifying that it resides within the intended products/ directory or checking for relative directory traversal (..) sequences, enabling authorized staff operators to overwrite arbitrary assets across the bucket.
root_cause: server/routes/adminRoutes.ts line 177 uses req.body.path directly without traversal sequence sanitization or prefix constraints.
intended_behavior: The uploadPath should be strictly generated server-side or forced to remain within the products/ directory without allowing parent directory traversal (..) sequences.

trace.description: Assigns uploadPath = path || defaultPath without traversal sanitization.
Uploads buffer to supabaseServer.storage with upsert: true using unvalidated uploadPath.

conditions.description: Attacker holds STAFF or ADMIN role.

instructions: 1. Send HTTP POST /api/admin/upload-image with valid staff authorization header.
2. Supply path parameter targeting a different file key or using traversal sequences.
3. Observe that Supabase storage receives the unvalidated path and overwrites existing asset due to upsert: true.
execution.observed_result: Server accepts unvalidated path and uploads image to arbitrary bucket location.

remediation.strategy: Sanitize path by removing parent traversal sequences (..) and ensuring it begins with products/.

code_changes.fixed_code:
const cleanPath = typeof path === "string" && !path.includes("..") && path.startsWith("products/") ? path.trim() : null;
  const uploadPath = cleanPath || `products/${Date.now()}-${fileName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.-]/g, "_")}`;

likelihood.reason: Requires authenticated STAFF or ADMIN account credentials.

impact.reason: Allows overwriting existing brand assets or images in the Supabase product-images storage bucket.

confidence.reason: Confirmed by source code inspection in server/routes/adminRoutes.ts lines 177-184.

title: Unescaped User Input in Transactional Email Templates Enables HTML Injection
description: In server/services/notificationService.ts, customer-controlled fields submitted in bulk enquiries (contact_name, organization_name, notes, delivery_address) and order recipient names are interpolated directly into raw HTML email strings without escaping. An attacker can inject arbitrary HTML markup, styles, or phishing links into emails delivered to the store administrator inbox or customer acknowledgement emails.
root_cause: notifyNewBulkEnquiry and notifyOrderPlaced in server/services/notificationService.ts interpolate raw customer strings into HTML strings instead of calling the escapeHtml helper.
intended_behavior: All customer-supplied strings must be escaped using escapeHtml before being interpolated into HTML email templates.

trace.description: Receives contact_name, organization_name, and notes from unauthenticated user request.
Interpolates unescaped contact_name, organization_name, and notes into email HTML string.

conditions.description: Recipient opens the generated transactional notification email in an HTML email client.

execution.attacker_perspective: External unauthenticated visitor submitting a bulk enquiry
payloads: {"contact_name":"Security Test TEST","phone":"9876543210","event_date":"2026-12-01","notes":"Click here to confirm quote"}
instructions: 1. Send HTTP POST /api/enquiries with HTML tags in contact_name and notes.
2. Inspect the generated email HTML dispatched to store owner.
3. Observe that raw HTML tags are rendered into the outgoing message body without entity encoding.
execution.observed_result: Email template renders raw HTML tags directly in outgoing email.

remediation.strategy: Wrap all enquiry fields in escapeHtml() before interpolating them into HTML email templates.

likelihood.reason: Anyone can submit public bulk enquiries without authentication.

impact.reason: Enables HTML formatting injection and phishing link insertion into admin notifications; modern email clients sandbox scripts.

confidence.reason: Directly verified in server/services/notificationService.ts lines 1154-1188 where escapeHtml was omitted.

title: Public Bulk Enquiry Endpoint Lacks Dedicated Rate Limiting Guarding Outbound Email Quota
description: POST /api/enquiries is mounted in server.ts without dedicated rate limiting or IP burst controls. Each submission triggers outbound transactional emails via ZeptoMail to both the store owner and customer, potentially allowing automated scripts to flood the owner inbox or consume monthly transactional email quotas.
claimed_root_cause: server.ts line 154 mounts publicRoutes without dedicated rate limiter for POST /api/enquiries.

trace.description: Mounts publicRoutes without dedicated enquiry rate limiter.
Dispatches outbound emails via ZeptoMail API.

blockers: Production ZeptoMail account quota tier, delivery rate caps, and upstream Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rules are not observable from repository source alone.

validation_plan.local: Execute a script sending 50 consecutive POST /api/enquiries requests to verify if throttling triggers.
validation_plan.deployment: Check ZeptoMail dashboard account limits and configure a Cloudflare WAF rate limiting rule on POST /api/enquiries.
